identity.name: Journal of Shoulder and Elbow Surgery
identity.source_note: Live guide is blocked to automated fetch (ScienceDirect CAPTCHA). source_hash is the SHA-256 of the normalized RAW Internet Archive snapshot of the official guide (web.archive.org/web/20240225180329id_/https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-shoulder-and-elbow-surgery/publish/guide-for-authors, captured 2024-02-25 (~2.4y old — prioritize re-verification)) and is reproducible. Rules were encoded from this Internet Archive snapshot. Session C's freshness cron must use a headless fetch to re-verify the live page.

encoding_notes: Live ScienceDirect Guide-for-Authors is bot-protected (curl/WebFetch/headless render all 403 or CAPTCHA). Rules encoded from the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2024-02-25 of the same URL. source_hash is of the live CAPTCHA shell, which embeds a per-request reference number and is therefore not stably reproducible.

JSES redirects many case reports and reviews to sister journals (JSES International, JSES Reviews Reports & Techniques, Seminars in Arthroplasty: JSES); article_types reflect the types JSES itself lists as accepted for publication.

Word cap of 4,750 covers abstract + introduction + materials/methods + results + discussion + conclusion for review and original articles; case reports must not exceed 2,250 words and do not require an abstract; letters to the editor are limited to ~2 printed pages (no word count) -> letter/technical_note/editorial omitted from word_limits.

References are Vancouver style but modified: alphabetical order by first author, numbered sequentially, cited in text as superscript Arabic numerals WITHOUT brackets (order 'alphabetical', in_text 'superscript'). List all authors when <=6, else first 6 then 'et al.' (et_al_threshold 6). A DOI is required at the end of each reference dated 2002 or later (include_doi true).

Tables are uploaded as separate files and numbered in ROMAN numerals; figure and table legends go on a dedicated legends page after the reference list, so caption_position is null (not above/below the object).
Figures uploaded as separate files in .tif or .jpg; specific min DPI is deferred to elsevier.com/artworkinstructions -> min_dpi null.

Margins 'at least 25 mm (1 inch)' -> 25.4 mm all sides. Times New Roman 12, double spacing, and continuous line numbering are explicitly required. The guide does not mention page numbers -> page_numbers.show false; page_size/alignment/first_line_indent/per-level heading rules not specified -> null.
The running title is a six-word short-form placed in the header space; encoded via running_head.show and the title_page running_title element (no character cap given -> running_title_max_chars null).

A 'Declaration of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process' is required as a manuscript section immediately before the References; it has no DECLARATION_ELEMENTS key and is tracked out-of-schema.

Two cover letters are required (submission/originality statement + a signed combined conflict-of-interest statement); cover_letter_required true. Conflict-of-interest and IRB/ethics approval are also stated on the title page (required declarations). ORCID is not mentioned in the guide -> orcid_required false.
scrub_metadata is inferred from the mandated text blinding (blind institution location, author initials, and self-citations), not stated verbatim.
For full research articles, a Level of Evidence and 6-8 keywords are appended to the abstract.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
